specs.value: External canister filter with built-in quick-start priming device
3.5 l (Greendeal); 4.7 l (Tạp hóa thủy sinh) – shops disagree
No more than 180 cm from the water surface to the bottom of the filter
Water surface must be at least 20 cm above the top of the filter
Locking clips made of glass-fibre-reinforced plastic
Filter, 12/16 hoses and pipes, intake basket, angle piece, suction holders, biofilter balls and biofilter foam
2 years, plus 2 more years when the product is registered; does not cover wear parts such as the impeller and shaft
Shops say it uses up to 27% less power than comparable filters
TÜV-certified for safety and energy saving (per the shop listing)

prices.variant: e902 greenline (reference price; order by phone or in store)

fits.fact: JBL rates it for tanks of about 90–300 l, or 80–120 cm long.
Greendeal recommends it for tanks up to 300 l or 90–120 cm long.
For tanks under 90 l the e402 or e702 is the better match; for 160–600 l tanks JBL makes the e1502.
It must sit no more than 180 cm below the water surface. If placed beside the tank, the water surface must be at least 20 cm above the top of the filter.

usage.fact: Stand the filter on its four rubber feet so only the feet touch the cabinet, and keep the hoses from touching the cabinet to avoid transmitting vibration.
Before first use, press the start button firmly until it clicks once to activate it.
To prime, hold the outlet pipe above the water and press START until water runs into the IN hose. Let the filter fill completely, then plug it in.
A new filter may gurgle for 5–7 days while trapped air escapes.
Clean the hoses regularly with a hose brush, because warm-water rinsing does not remove biofilm.
Clean the impeller housing, impeller and shaft with a suitable brush during maintenance.
Hose connections rotate 360° and there is a water-stop valve, so the filter can be disconnected for cleaning.

issues.fact: JBL says loud running usually comes from a worn or dirt-clogged impeller, a throttled flow, or too little height difference between the water and the filter head. Resonance can carry through the lid, cabinet or hoses, and a soft mat underneath helps.

The impeller is a wear part that the warranty does not cover. When it wears out, replace the impeller, shaft and both rubber bearings together. A bearing often sticks in the housing, and JBL sells a pulling tool to remove it.
Gurgling from trapped air during the first week is normal.
Compared with the older e901, the e902 has a patented pre-filter with twice the surface area.
Vietnamese shops list different media volumes (3.5 l vs 4.7 l) and slightly different dimensions, so check the figures before buying.
I found no independent forum reports of leaks or durability problems with the e902.

alternatives.why: Cheaper option for tanks of 60–200 l: 700 l/h at 9 W, about 3.275.000₫ at Sinh Cảnh Việt.
Bigger option for 160–600 l tanks: 1400 l/h at 20 W.
Well-known, simple filter for tanks of about 120–350 l: roughly 620 l/h at 15 W. It has less flow than the e902 but is very reliable. I couldn't find a Vietnamese shop price.
